title: A Grignard-mediated route to access 4-substituted-3-E-styryl-2H-chromenes: alternate extrinsic FRET probes to explore the IIA and IIIA subdomains of serum proteins
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4750-4765
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07616A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Soumyadipta Rakshit, Sanjay Bhar, Rimi Roy
A facile and efficient strategy to construct 2H-chromene scaffolds, employing variably substituted spiro-4-oxochroman-3,1′-cyclopropane precursors under mild conditions, is proposed in this study.
